lines.en: label halloween14:
scene mollydrunk1
: U-Umm! Molly! I think you may have had a little too much to drink...
lines.zh: : 那、那个！Molly！我觉得你可能喝得有点太多了……

lines.en: : NONSENSE, FUTABA! IF 'ME FAT'ER COULD SEE ME NOW, HE’D BE PROUD!
lines.zh: : 胡说八道，Futaba！要是俺老爹现在看到俺，他会骄傲死的！

lines.en: : SURE, HE’D PROBABLY SAY 'ME SKIRT IS A LITTLE TOO SHORT AND T'AT I DON’T NEED AN EYEPATCH-
lines.zh: : 当然，他大概会说俺裙子有点太短，还说俺没必要戴什么眼罩——

lines.en: : AND T'AT I SPEND TOO MUCH TIME PLAYIN' GAMES AND SHOULD PROBABLY MAKE SOME “REAL FRIENDS” BUT-
lines.zh: : 还有俺花太多时间打游戏，该去交些“真正的朋友”，但是——

lines.en: scene mollydrunk2
: Hey wait a *hic* sec. T'even are real friends? Aren’t the ones I have online just as good?
lines.zh: : 嘿等等，*嗝* 咱想想啊。啥才叫真正的朋友？俺在网上交的那些不也一样好吗？

lines.en: scene mollydrunk3
: ACCEPT ME FOR WHO I AM, DAD!
lines.zh: : 接受真实的俺吧，老爹！

lines.en: : AND STOP LOOKING UNDER MY BED! IT’S WHERE I KEEP ALL THE GOOD STUFF!
lines.zh: : 还有别再往俺床底下看了！好东西都在那儿呢！

lines.en: : I’m not your father. I’m Futaba. And I don’t care what you keep under your bed.
lines.zh: : 我不是你爸。我是Futaba。我也不在乎你床底下放了什么。

lines.en: : I just think it might be good if you calmed down a bit before you hurt anyone. Or yourself.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，在你伤到别人或者伤到自己之前，最好先冷静一下。

lines.en: scene mollydrunk4
: Ta’ heck ye talkin’ about wit’ all ‘tis hurtin eachot’er nonsense?
lines.zh: : 你这说的都是啥伤来伤去的鬼话？

lines.en: : T’ain’t even possible for me ta hurt a fly let alone anot’er human bein’.
lines.zh: : 俺连只苍蝇都伤不了，更别说另一个人了。

lines.en: : D’even if’a could, s’not like we ain’t already gonna die anyway.
lines.zh: : 再说就算能，反正我们横竖都是要死的。

lines.en: scene mollydrunk5
: LIVE, FUTABA! LIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIVE!!!!!!!!!
: I barely understood any of that...
lines.zh: : 我几乎一句都没听懂……

lines.en: scene mollydrunk6
: Tsuneyo? What’s wrong? Why are you looking at me like that?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo？你怎么了？干嘛那样看着我？

lines.en: : I’ve done a bad thing.
lines.zh: : 我做了件坏事。

lines.en: : ...Okay?
lines.zh: : ……然后呢？

lines.en: : I let the Emerald Guardian consume too many alcohols and now she thinks Futaba is her dad.
lines.zh: : 我让翡翠守护者喝了太多酒精，现在她把Futaba当成她爸了。

lines.en: : Yeah, I can hear her yelling from all the way over here, but why does that mean you have to put your hand on my shoulder?
lines.zh: : 是啊，我在这么远的地方都能听见她在喊，可这跟你把手放我肩膀上有什么关系？

lines.en: : That just kind of happened.
lines.zh: : 就是不知不觉就放上去了。

lines.en: : This fabric is soft.
lines.zh: : 这布料很软。

lines.en: : Th-thanks...I sewed it myself.
lines.zh: : 谢、谢谢……我自己缝的。

lines.en: : I am impressed, but there are more important matters at hand.
lines.zh: : 我很佩服，但眼下还有更要紧的事。

lines.en: : Are you able to do anything to fix the Emerald Guardian?
lines.zh: : 你能不能想办法治好翡翠守护者？

lines.en: scene mollydrunk7
: I don’t really know if there’s anything you can do to fix a drunk person.
lines.zh: : 我还真不知道有什么办法能治好一个喝醉的人。

lines.en: : So she will remain this way forever?
lines.zh: : 所以她会永远这样下去了？

lines.en: : Well, no...she’ll probably go back to normal tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不会……她明天大概就会恢复正常。

lines.en: : But I don’t know if ‘normal’ for Molly really matches the ‘normal’ for everybody else.
lines.zh: : 不过我不知道Molly的“正常”跟大家伙的“正常”是不是一回事。

lines.en: : And to think that mere hours ago we were sharing both tears and a man.
lines.zh: : 想想看，就在几个小时前，我们还一起分享眼泪和同一个男人。

lines.en: : It pains me to see how far she’s fallen.
lines.zh: : 看到她堕落成这样，我很痛心。

lines.en: scene mollydrunk8
: Wait, what do you mean by sharing a man? There is only one man around here and he is my [uncle].
lines.zh: : 等等，分享同一个男人是什么意思？这附近只有一个男人，而他是我的[uncle]。

lines.en: : Correct. He taught us a valuable lesson about life and then took us into his arms.
lines.zh: : 没错。他教了我们一堂宝贵的人生课，然后把我们拥入怀中。

lines.en: : It was a gripping moment.
lines.zh: : 那是个紧扣人心的瞬间。

lines.en: : I don’t care what it-
lines.zh: : 我才不管那是什么——

lines.en: : Get it? Gripping?
lines.zh: : 听懂了吗？紧扣？

lines.en: : As in we were gripping each other.
lines.zh: : 就是我们紧紧扣住彼此。

lines.en: : Like a hug.
lines.zh: : 像拥抱那样。

lines.en: : It is a joke.
lines.zh: : 这是个笑话。

lines.en: : Please laugh. I need the encouragement.
lines.zh: : 请笑一下吧。我需要鼓励。

lines.en: scene mollydrunk9
: Don’t touch my [uncle] anymore! I don’t care what kind of lesson it involves!
lines.zh: : 别再碰我的[uncle]了！我不管那是什么课！

lines.en: : And don’t touch me either!
lines.zh: : 还有也别碰我！

lines.en: : I’m so sorry. I just feel compelled to keep touching members of your family for some reason.
lines.zh: : 非常抱歉。我就是不知为何，总觉得非得去碰你们家的成员。

lines.en: : I will try and be better.
lines.zh: : 我会努力改的。

lines.en: scene mollydrunk10
: Huh? Well, I mean...I guess I’m not really mad or anything...just kind of jealous.
lines.zh: : 哈？嗯，我是说……我也没真的生气什么的……就是有点吃醋。

lines.en: : But I’m sure you wouldn’t do anything weird with him anyway so-
lines.zh: : 不过我肯定你也不会对他做什么奇怪的事，所以——

lines.en: : Everything I do is weird, so I probably would.
lines.zh: : 我做的每件事都很奇怪，所以我大概会。

lines.en: : Yeah, but...
lines.zh: : 是没错，可是……

lines.en: : Oh well. I guess it doesn’t really matter.
lines.zh: : 算了。反正也无所谓。

lines.en: scene mollydrunk11
: Heeeeey. Know what'cha need, Futaba?
lines.zh: : 嘿————。Futaba，知道你需要啥不？

lines.en: : Ya need a good ole’ beer. T’will solve all ‘yer problems.
lines.zh: : 你需要一罐上好的啤酒。那能解决你所有的问题。

lines.en: : D’offer ya some a’ mine but t’would be an indirect kiss.
lines.zh: : 俺倒是想分你点俺的，可那就成间接接吻了。

lines.en: : Kinda like one 'a t’ose yuri shows where ‘ta girl gets all embarrassed ‘cause she ain’t aware she likes girls yet.
lines.zh: : 有点像那种百合动画，女孩会特别害臊，因为她还没意识到自己喜欢女生。

lines.en: : Put down the can, Molly. Please.
lines.zh: : 把罐子放下，Molly。拜托。

lines.en: : I’d take it out of your hands but I’m afraid you’ll spill it all over me and this costume was kind of expensive to make.
lines.zh: : 我倒是想从你手里抢过来，但我怕你全洒我身上，这套衣服做起来还挺贵的。

lines.en: : Ha! ‘Yer tellin’ me. Have any idea how many lattes I needed ‘ta make to buy ‘ta fabric for ‘tis dress?
lines.zh: : 哈！还用你说。你知道为了买这条裙子的布料，俺得做多少杯拿铁吗？

lines.en: : Like a kadrillionbilliontrillion!
lines.zh: : 大概有亿兆京垓那么多！

lines.en: : Fookin’ crazy if ‘ye ask me. S’just coffee, ain’t it? Can fookin’ make it in ‘yer room f’ya really want.
lines.zh: : 要俺说真是他妈的疯了。不就是咖啡吗？要想喝，在自己屋里就能他妈的做。

lines.en: scene mollydrunk12
: ‘Tis little can ‘a paradise, t’ough. Y’can’t make ‘tis in ‘yer room. I’ll tell ya ‘tat much.
lines.zh: : 不过这小罐子里装的可真是天堂。这玩意你在自己屋里可做不出来。这点俺可以保证。

lines.en: scene mollydrunk13
: DAD! WHERE ARE ‘YE?! LOOK AT WHAT ‘YER DAUGHTER HAS BECOME!
lines.zh: : 老爹！你在哪儿？！看看你女儿变成什么样了！

lines.en: : ‘FONLY ‘YE WERE MORE ACCEPTIN’ OF ME AT A YOUNG AGE! I WOULDN’T HAVE TURNED TO ‘TA DRINK!
lines.zh: : 要是你从小就更能接受俺一点！俺也不会借酒浇愁！

lines.en: : I HOPE ‘YER HAPPY NOW! DAD!!
lines.zh: : 我希望你现在满意了！老爹！！

lines.en: : AHHHHHHH!!!!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！

lines.en: scene mollydrunk14
: Oh you’ve gotta be fucking kidding me.
lines.zh: : 哦，你他妈在逗我吧。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Is Molly drunk? Is that what she’s been doing this entire time?
lines.zh: : Molly喝醉了？她从头到尾都在干这个？

lines.en: : I didn’t even realize there was alcohol here.
lines.zh: : 我都没意识到这儿有酒。

lines.en: : She must have went looking for it or something. It’s like she’s trying to be a stereotype.
lines.zh: : 她肯定是自己去找的什么的。搞得跟非要活成刻板印象似的。

lines.en: : How much do you even need to drink to start acting like that?
lines.zh: : 到底得喝多少才会变成那样？

lines.en: scene mollydrunk15
: I have no idea, but I can’t help but feel like we should maybe do something about it.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道，但我忍不住觉得，我们大概该做点什么。

lines.en: : Where is Sensei when you need him? Or Makoto for that matter?
lines.zh: : 需要Sensei的时候他在哪儿？Makoto也行啊？

lines.en: : He’s probably the one who did this in the first place.
lines.zh: : 搞不好一开始就是他干的。

lines.en: : He would be of no help here.
lines.zh: : 他在这儿帮不上任何忙。

lines.en: : Yeah, I think this might just be something Molly has to deal with alone.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我觉得这可能得Molly自己扛过去。

lines.en: scene mollydrunk16
: Aren’t you two really good friends? Isn’t there something you can say to her that would calm her down?
lines.zh: : 你们两个不是好朋友吗？就没点什么话能让她冷静下来？

lines.en: : The only thing I can think of is giving her more until she passes out and I think you might be talking about something different.
lines.zh: : 我唯一能想到的就是再给她灌点，直到她昏过去，我觉得你说的可能不是这个意思。

lines.en: : Oh God...
lines.zh: : 天啊……

lines.en: : I think...I think I should go do something about this.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……我觉得我该去做点什么。

lines.en: : Well, uh...good luck? I’m gonna hang out over here where it’s still safe.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那个……祝你好运？我待在这边安全的地方就好。

lines.en: scene black
Somewhere nearby...
lines.zh: 不远处……

lines.en: : Well, that definitely wasn’t what I had in mind when Makoto said she had something to talk about.
lines.zh: : 好吧，Makoto说有事要谈的时候，我脑子里想的绝对不是这个。

lines.en: I make my way out of the guest room and head back toward the main hall to join the girls for the rest of the party.
lines.zh: 我走出客房，朝大厅走去，回去跟女孩们一起参加派对剩下的部分。

lines.en: Makoto wanted to rest for a while after losing her virginity (Which is fair, I guess), so I’m heading back alone.
lines.zh: Makoto失去处女之身后想休息一会儿（这要求挺合理，我想），所以我一个人先回去。

lines.en: Which, now that I think about it, is actually pretty good for me.
lines.zh: 现在想想，这对我其实挺有利的。

lines.en: I can probably say I just had to bring her home early because she was feeling sick or something.
lines.zh: 我大概可以说，她身体不舒服，所以我提前把她送回家了。

lines.en: Here’s hoping Makoto can’t summon the strength to move her legs and destroy that excuse for me.
lines.zh: 但愿Makoto没力气挪动她的腿，把我的借口给毁了。

lines.en: Now, to get back to-
lines.zh: 好了，回到——

lines.en: scene mollydrunk17
: WHERE ON EARTH HAVE YOU BEEN?!
lines.zh: : 你到底跑哪儿去了？！

lines.en: : Molly is drunk, Miku looks all upset, and Tsuneyo [molest]ed me!
lines.zh: : Molly喝醉了，Miku看起来很难过，还有Tsuneyo[molest]了我！

lines.en: : I was walking Makoto back-
lines.zh: : 我刚才在送Makoto回去——

lines.en: : Wait, what was that last one?
lines.zh: : 等等，最后那个是什么？

lines.en: : Well, it wasn’t like, actually [molesting] me, but she touched my shoulder for a really long time and kept staring into my eyes like she was in love with me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，也不算真的[molesting]我，但她摸我肩膀摸了特别久，还一直盯着我的眼睛看，像是爱上我了似的。

lines.en: : Oh. Well that’s significantly less exciting.
lines.zh: : 哦。那可就没那么刺激了。

lines.en: I turn away from Ami for a moment and address the girl behind her.
lines.zh: 我暂时从Ami身上移开视线，跟她身后的女孩打招呼。

lines.en: : Happy birthday, Yumi. I’m glad you could make it.
lines.zh: : 生日快乐，Yumi。我很高兴你能来。

lines.en: scene mollydrunk18
: Oh. Uhh, thanks I guess.
lines.zh: : 哦。呃，谢了，大概吧。

lines.en: : Back to normal now?
lines.zh: : 现在恢复正常了？

lines.en: : What do you mean by-
lines.zh: : 你这么说是想——

lines.en: : Sensei! You need to do something.
lines.zh: : Sensei！你得做点什么。

lines.en: scene mollydrunk19
: Do something about what?
lines.zh: : 做什么？

lines.en: : The drunk [teenager] that Futaba and Chika are trying to calm down as we speak!
lines.zh: : 那个喝醉的[teenager]啊！Futaba和Chika这会儿正在试着让她冷静下来呢！

lines.en: : I’m sure they’re a lot better at handling something like that than I would be.
lines.zh: : 我相信她们处理这种事比我拿手多了。

lines.en: : Probably. You’d just take advantage of her or something.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。你搞不好还会趁机占她便宜什么的。

lines.en: : Thanks, Yumi. Again, really glad you could make it.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Yumi。再次重申，很高兴你能来。

lines.en: scene mollydrunk20
: For real, though! Where were you? And what happened to Makoto?
lines.zh: : 不过说真的！你刚才在哪儿？Makoto怎么了？

lines.en: : She was feeling sick so I walked her...somewhere.
lines.zh: : 她说不舒服，所以我把她送到……某个地方去了。

lines.en: : Somewhere?
lines.zh: : 某个地方？

lines.en: : So you just...left her in a random place while she was feeling sick?
lines.zh: : 所以你就在她不舒服的时候……把她随便丢在某个地方了？

lines.en: : Sure, yeah. That sounds about right.
lines.zh: : 对，没错。差不多就是这样。

lines.en: scene mollydrunk21
: Oh, okay. Well that sounds good to me.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。听起来挺好的。

lines.en: scene mollydrunk22
: But you’ve still gotta do something about-
lines.zh: : 但你还是得处理一下——

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. I’ll try.
lines.zh: : 行行行。我试试。

lines.en: : Not making any promises, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我不打包票。

lines.en: scene black
I step away from Ami, who follows closely behind me as I make my way over to Molly, Futaba, and Chika.
lines.zh: 我从Ami身边走开，她紧紧跟在我后面，我朝Molly、Futaba和Chika走去。

lines.en: scene mollydrunk23
: Heeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeey~
: How about you an’ me get outta here and go play some games at my place, Sir?
lines.zh: : 咱俩离开这儿，去俺家打游戏怎么样，先生？

lines.en: : I’ve got a whole drawer o’ stuff I t’ink ya’d be really into.
lines.zh: : 俺有一整抽屉的东西，我觉得你会很感兴趣的。

lines.en: : Weird. I don’t remember her accent being this strong a few hours ago.
lines.zh: : 奇怪。我不记得几小时前她口音有这么重。

lines.en: : I think drinking made it a lot worse than it normally is.
lines.zh: : 我觉得是酒把她平时的口音放大了很多。

lines.en: : T’aint true one bit. Drinkin’ don’t make any’tin worse. Right, Sir?
lines.zh: : 才不是呢。喝酒哪会让什么变糟。对吧，先生？

lines.en: : Sohowaboutit? We gonna get outta here? ‘Ye gonna princess carry me and make me into a real wom-
lines.zh: : 所以到底怎么样？咱要走了吗？你要不要公主抱俺，把俺变成一个真正的女——

lines.en: scene mollydrunk24
: *hic*
: Guh...
: I t'ink I’m gonna t'row up...
lines.zh: : 俺觉得俺要吐了……

lines.en: : Just take it easy, Molly. Try not to talk too much.
lines.zh: : 别急，Molly。尽量别说话。

lines.en: : In fact, it would probably be really really good if you didn’t talk at all, okay?
lines.zh: : 事实上，你要是干脆一句话都不说，那大概会非常非常好，好吗？

lines.en: : Do you need some water? Bread?
lines.zh: : 需要喝点水吗？面包？

lines.en: : Well, actually, I don’t think there’s any bread here. Would...wedding cake help?
lines.zh: : 嗯，其实我觉得这儿没有面包。那……结婚蛋糕行吗？

lines.en: scene mollydrunk25
: I’m gonna *hic* miss you so much, Sir. I don’t want a new teacher.
lines.zh: : 俺会*嗝*超级想你的，先生。我不想要新老师。

lines.en: : Maybe...you could tell her to stop talking, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 也许……你能让她别再说话了，Sensei？

lines.en: : Everything I say to her is just going over her head.
lines.zh: : 我说什么她都当耳旁风。

lines.en: : Molly...you could very well be in Sensei’s class again next year. You don’t know that you're not yet.
lines.zh: : Molly……你明年说不定就在Sensei班上呢。你还不知道会不会呢。

lines.en: : We need to *hic* spend more time together before it'sss...toolate...
lines.zh: : 我们得*嗝*多花点时间在一起，不然就……太迟了……

lines.en: : 'Yer 'ta only one I trust wit’ my *hic* phone...Sir...
lines.zh: : 俺*嗝*只放心把手机交给你……先生……

lines.en: : Her...phone?
lines.zh: : 她的……手机？

lines.en: : Are you guys like, texting buddies or something?
lines.zh: : 你们是那种会互发短信的关系还是什么？

lines.en: : I don’t even have Molly’s phone number, so no.
lines.zh: : 我连Molly的电话号码都没有，所以不是。

lines.en: : All ‘ye gotta do is ask!
lines.zh: : 你只要开口问就行了！

lines.en: : I gots...plenty’a stickers ‘ta send ‘ye on LINE, man.
lines.zh: : 俺有一大堆贴图可以在 LINE 上发给你，老兄。

lines.en: : And a bunch of cosplay photos just *hic* pickin’ up dust in me’ camera roll.
lines.zh: : 还有一堆 cosplay 照片在俺相册里*嗝*吃灰呢。

lines.en: scene mollydrunk26
: *hic*
: Just gonna rest me eyes for a wee bit.
lines.zh: : 俺就稍微闭会儿眼睛。

lines.en: : T’would be a shame if someone were ‘ta take advantage of me in ‘me drunken stupor.
lines.zh: : 要是有谁趁俺醉得不省人事占俺便宜，那可就太不像话了。

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t think that will be happening tonight.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我觉得今晚不会发生那种事。

lines.en: : Or any night.
lines.zh: : 或者说任何一晚都不会。

lines.en: : ...Or any night.
lines.zh: : ……或者说任何一晚都不会。

lines.en: scene mollydrunk27
: So what do we do now?
lines.zh: : 那我们现在怎么办？

lines.en: : The party isn’t supposed to end for another few hours and I don’t think Molly can carry on much longer.
lines.zh: : 派对还有几个小时才结束，我觉得Molly撑不了那么久了。

lines.en: : Maybe there’s like, a guest room or something we could-
lines.zh: : 也许有，比如说，客房之类的，我们可以——

lines.en: : Nope. No guest rooms here.
lines.zh: : 没有。这儿没有客房。

lines.en: scene mollydrunk28
: You checked already?
lines.zh: : 你查过了？

lines.en: : Yeah, earlier when I was setting the place up with Makoto.
lines.zh: : 嗯，之前和Makoto布置场地的时候查过。

lines.en: : The only spare room is full of...spare party stuff.
lines.zh: : 唯一的空房间堆满了……派对备用品。

lines.en: : You mean like extra chairs or something?
lines.zh: : 你是说多余的椅子之类的？

lines.en: : Yes. That is exactly what I mean.
lines.zh: : 对。我就是这个意思。

lines.en: : Well, I suppose we could ask Ayane if it’s okay to have Molly sleep in her room.
lines.zh: : 那，我们可以问问Ayane，能不能让Molly睡她房间。

lines.en: : That seems like a much better idea.
lines.zh: : 那主意好多了。

lines.en: I don’t even know if Makoto was able to dress herself after we finished having sex.
lines.zh: 我甚至都不知道我们做完之后，Makoto有没有力气自己穿好衣服。

lines.en: I can’t imagine that someone walking into a spare room and finding her laying there passed out and covered in semen would be a good look for either of us.
lines.zh: 我可想象不出，有人走进那间空房间，发现她躺在那儿昏睡不醒、浑身是精液，这对我们俩来说会是什么好果子。

lines.en: So...Sorry, Molly. Looks like you’ll need to travel a tiny bit further in order to get some rest tonight.
lines.zh: 所以……抱歉了，Molly。看来你今晚得再走远一点才能休息了。

lines.en: : I’m fiiiiiiiiine. T’ings like t’is are bound ‘ta happen when ya have a bit much.
lines.zh: : 俺没事————。喝多了一点，这种事难免的。

lines.en: : I’ve got *hic* Irish, blood. I’m...ready to go!
lines.zh: : 俺有*嗝*爱尔兰血统。俺……准备好了！

lines.en: scene mollydrunk29
: ‘Ye hear t’at, Sir? I’m *hic* ready to go. In more ways t’an one.
lines.zh: : 你听到了吗，先生？俺*嗝*准备好了。从各种意义上都准备好了。

lines.en: : H-scene *hic* incoming~
lines.zh: : H 场景*嗝*即将到来~

lines.en: : I don’t know what an H-scene is but I feel like I don’t approve of it.
lines.zh: : 我不知道 H 场景是什么，但我觉得我不赞成。

lines.en: : You don’t. I can confirm that for you.
lines.zh: : 你确实不会赞成。这点我可以替你确认。

lines.en: : Maybe we should just leave her here after all?
lines.zh: : 要不我们干脆把她留在这儿算了？

lines.en: : Yes, I think that might be for the best.
lines.zh: : 好，我觉得那样最好。

lines.en: I feel my phone vibrate through my pocket and pull it to see that I’m getting a call from...
lines.zh: 我感觉到口袋里的手机震动，掏出来一看，来电的是……

lines.en: Haruka?
lines.zh: Haruka？

lines.en: What does she want right now?
lines.zh: 她这会儿找我干什么？

lines.en: scene mollydrunk30
: Hello?
: Tch! Stupid phones. Stealin ‘me teacher away from me.
lines.zh: : 切！破手机。把俺的老师从俺身边抢走。

lines.en: : HEY, PENIS MAN.
lines.zh: : 嘿，鸡巴男。

lines.en: : Hello, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 你好，Haruka。

lines.en: : I’M DRUNK~
lines.zh: : 我醉了~

lines.en: : Yes, I can tell.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我听出来了。

lines.en: : Wanna come fix my pipes?
lines.zh: : 要不要来修修我的水管？

lines.en: : I’m kind of in the middle of-
lines.zh: : 我正忙着——

lines.en: : Maki’s pipes too~
lines.zh: : Maki的水管也要~

lines.en: I hang up the phone and turn back to the girls, ready to disappoint them.
lines.zh: 我挂断电话，转回女孩们这边，准备让她们失望了。

lines.en: : Duty calls.
lines.zh: : 有任务。

lines.en: scene mollydrunk31
: Huh? Who was that?
lines.zh: : 哈？谁啊？

lines.en: : Is something wrong, Sensei? Are you leaving already?
lines.zh: : 出什么事了吗，Sensei？你这就走了？

lines.en: : A friend of mine is having a bit of an emergency and needs my help as soon as possible.
lines.zh: : 一个朋友遇到点紧急情况，需要我尽快过去帮忙。

lines.en: : Is everything okay? Because we’re having a bit of an emergency here as well.
lines.zh: : 一切都还好吗？因为我们这儿也有点紧急情况。

lines.en: : I can *hic* stand. T’aint no emergency here.
lines.zh: : 俺*嗝*能站。这儿没有紧急情况。

lines.en: : I’m *hic* fine on ‘me own ‘til ‘me legs give out.
lines.zh: : 在俺的腿撑不住之前，俺*嗝*一个人也没问题。

lines.en: : Help 'yer friend...
lines.zh: : 去帮你朋友吧……

lines.en: scene mollydrunk32
: BUT KNOW T'IS, SIR.
lines.zh: : 但你要记住，先生。

lines.en: : EVEN IF YE' LEAVE ME HERE FOREVER-
lines.zh: : 就算你把我永远丢在这儿——

lines.en: : I WILL ALWAYS LOVE YOU!
lines.zh: : 我永远都爱你！

lines.en: scene mollydrunk33
: T’s wit’ all ‘ta starin’? I saw him first so he belongs ‘ta me!
lines.zh: : 都盯着我看干嘛？是我先看到他的，所以他是属于我的！

lines.en: : You were actually one of the last people to see him.
lines.zh: : 你其实是最晚见到他的人之一。

lines.en: : Sensei doesn’t believe in love in the first place.
lines.zh: : Sensei压根就不相信爱情。

lines.en: : As much as I’d like to stay here and argue over Molly’s love for me, I really do need to get going.
lines.zh: : 虽然我很想留在这儿，为Molly对我的爱争论一番，但我真的得走了。

lines.en: Like Hell am I going to miss the chance for a threesome with Haruka and Maki, even if this room is packed to the brim with other equally cute girls.
lines.zh: 就算这屋里挤满了同样可爱的女孩，我也绝不可能放过和Haruka、Maki玩三人行的机会。

lines.en: scene mollydrunk34
: Well, I guess we’ll...see you in[school] tomorrow then?
lines.zh: : 那，我们……明天[school]见？

lines.en: : I ain’t comin’ to *hic*[school] tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 俺明天*嗝*不来[school]。

lines.en: : Or ever again! I quit!
lines.zh: : 或者永远不来了！我退学了！

lines.en: : I’ll see all three of you tomorrow. Tell the others I said goodbye.
lines.zh: : 明天我会见到你们三个的。替我向大家道别。

lines.en: : I hope everything turns out okay.
lines.zh: : 我希望一切顺利。

lines.en: : We’ll take care of Molly, so don’t worry about that.
lines.zh: : 我们会照顾好Molly的，这点不用担心。

lines.en: : I’m not worried at all. Thanks, girls.
lines.zh: : 我一点都不担心。谢了，姑娘们。

lines.en: scene black
I use my phone to ping the closest cab and patiently tap my foot as I wait for it to show up at the Amamiya estate.
lines.zh: 我用手机叫了最近的一辆出租车，耐心地跺着脚，等它开到天宫宅邸。

lines.en: Haruka and Maki were all over each other at the bar last night, so I’d be excited going over there even if it was just to watch.
lines.zh: Haruka和Maki昨晚在酒吧里就黏在一起了，所以哪怕只是过去看着，我也够兴奋的了。

lines.en: I just hope this doesn’t wind up being some cruel practical joke where I’m actually being summoned to fix pipes.
lines.zh: 我只希望这不是什么恶毒的恶作剧——其实叫我来真的是修水管。

lines.en: Wait a minute.
lines.zh: 等一下。

lines.en: Am I really about to have a threesome with Maki when I just took her daughter’s virginity like an hour ago?
lines.zh: 我真的一小时前刚夺走她女儿的处女之身，现在就要和Maki玩三人行了吗？

lines.en: I deserve some sort of award for this, I think.
lines.zh: 我觉得我该为此拿个什么奖才对。
